name: Aoi Sena
source:
A third-year student at Suimei Academy.
[url=/c4655]Takumi[/url] first encounters her at school but quickly excuses himself after facing her ominous glare. She is often seen standing around Shibuya holding a very long sword and eating a light blue ice pop.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chaos;Head]Wikipedia[/url]]
